note: Illustrative layout. Each floor has its own canvas size (floors[].w and h); zones, structs and equipment carry a floor id. Exercise links live in exercises[].equipmentIds.

exercises.name: Incline walk
exercises.cue: Set a 4 to 8% incline, stand tall and keep a light touch on the rails.

exercises.name: Easy jog
exercises.cue: Conversational pace with relaxed shoulders and quick, light steps.

exercises.name: Interval run
exercises.cue: Hard efforts, easy recoveries. Keep your hands off the rails.

exercises.name: Steady state cross-train
exercises.cue: Push and pull the handles and stay tall through the chest.

exercises.name: Reverse stride
exercises.cue: Pedal backwards with a light grip and drive through the heels.

exercises.name: Step intervals
exercises.cue: Whole foot on each step and do not lean on the rails.

exercises.name: Steady climb
exercises.cue: Upright posture and a steady cadence.

exercises.name: Warm-up spin
exercises.cue: Light resistance and a smooth 80 to 90 rpm cadence.

exercises.name: Hill intervals
exercises.cue: Add resistance for the climb and stay seated and smooth.

exercises.name: 500 m repeats
exercises.cue: Legs, then body, then arms. Reverse the order on the way back.

exercises.name: Steady row
exercises.cue: Keep a strong, tall chest and a smooth stroke.

exercises.name: Sprint intervals
exercises.cue: Drive with arms and legs together and settle your breathing in the rests.

exercises.name: Calorie ladder
exercises.cue: Climb the calorie target each round and rest between rounds.

exercises.name: Interval ride
exercises.cue: Hard efforts on the beat, then easy spinning to recover.

exercises.name: Seated climb
exercises.cue: Heavy resistance, slow cadence, stay seated with relaxed hands.

exercises.name: Sprint repeats
exercises.cue: Short, maximal efforts with full recovery between.

exercises.name: Power test
exercises.cue: One maximal effort. Record the average watts to compare next time.

exercises.name: Seated chest press
exercises.cue: Handles at mid-chest height with shoulder blades pinned back.

exercises.name: Paused chest press
exercises.cue: Hold for a second at the chest, then press without shrugging.

exercises.name: Wide-grip pulldown
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbows, pull to the upper chest and keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pulldown
exercises.cue: Palms facing in, drive the elbows down towards your ribs.

exercises.name: Seated row
exercises.cue: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and avoid rocking the torso.

exercises.name: Single-arm row
exercises.cue: Brace the core and row to the hip.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.cue: Start with the handles at ear height and keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width, lower to about 90 degrees at the knee and do not lock out.

exercises.name: Single-leg press
exercises.cue: Keep the hips level and push through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Hips pressed into the seat and a slow, controlled return.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.cue: Brace, break at the hips and knees together and keep the whole foot planted.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.cue: Squeeze the glutes and press in a straight line.

exercises.name: Rack pull
exercises.cue: Bar at knee height, hinge and lock out by squeezing the glutes.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.cue: Elbows high, upright torso and stay balanced over the midfoot.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: Start from a full hang and pull the chest towards the bar.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.cue: Hinge to a flat back, row to the lower ribs and control the lowering.

exercises.name: Smith squat
exercises.cue: Feet slightly forward of the bar and keep the torso tall.

exercises.name: Smith split squat
exercises.cue: Long stride and drop the back knee straight down.

exercises.name: Smith incline press
exercises.cue: Lower to the upper chest and press without flaring the elbows.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar over midfoot, take the slack out of the bar and push the floor away.

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
exercises.cue: Drive through the floor and stand tall at the top.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, push the hips back and keep the bar close to the legs.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades tucked, feet planted and the bar to the lower chest.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.cue: Hands shoulder-width and elbows tucked close to the ribs.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Press through the heels and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.cue: Low hips, long strides and a steady push.

exercises.name: Sled pull
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly and take small, quick steps.

exercises.name: Alternating waves
exercises.cue: Slight squat, braced core and even waves.

exercises.name: Rope slams
exercises.cue: Lift with the hips and slam with intent.

exercises.name: Suspension row
exercises.cue: Body in a straight line and pull the chest to the handles.

exercises.name: Suspension push-up
exercises.cue: Keep the body rigid and control the lowering.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.cue: Land softly, stand tall on top and step down.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.cue: Drive through the lead heel and control the descent.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.cue: Hinge, then snap the hips. The bell floats to chest height.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at the chest and keep the elbows inside the knees.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Eyes on the bell and move one step at a time.

exercises.name: Farmer carry
exercises.cue: Stand tall with the shoulders back and walk with short steps.

exercises.name: Wall ball
exercises.cue: Squat deep, drive up and throw to the target.

exercises.name: Rotational throw
exercises.cue: Rotate through the hips and release with a strong exhale.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Push the hips back and keep the weights close and the back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cue: Press overhead without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Support one hand on the bench and row to the hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades down and back and lower to the chest line.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Bench at about 30 degrees and press up over the upper chest.

exercises.name: Bench-supported row
exercises.cue: Chest on the bench and row the elbows past your ribs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
exercises.cue: Long step, drop straight down and push back through the front heel.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on the bench and the front shin vertical.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows stay by the sides and no swinging.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.cue: Elbows point forward and do not flare.

exercises.name: Cable chop
exercises.cue: Rotate through the torso with straight arms and a braced core.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Pull to the face with the elbows high and squeeze the rear shoulders.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to the sides and a full lockout.

exercises.name: Cable row
exercises.cue: Sit tall and row the handle to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.cue: Soft elbows and bring the hands together in an arc.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Resist the pull, press out and hold, then return.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.cue: Hips square to the machine and kick straight back.

exercises.name: Cable biceps curl
exercises.cue: Keep the elbows fixed and curl in a smooth arc.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows fixed and a controlled lowering.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.cue: Press at an angle from the shoulder and keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
exercises.cue: Lower towards the forehead with the elbows pointing at the ceiling.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.cue: Upper arms flat on the pad and a controlled lowering.

exercises.name: Back extension
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips and stop when the body is in line.

exercises.name: Reverse hyper
exercises.cue: Swing the legs up with control and squeeze the glutes.

exercises.name: Plank hold
exercises.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight and a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Press the lower back into the floor and move opposite arm and leg slowly.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Reach long, keep the hips level and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: Stack the shoulders and hips and lift the hips high.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Body in a straight line and chest to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Weight in the heels and chest up.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.cue: Long step with a tall torso.

exercises.name: Step aerobics
exercises.cue: Follow the choreography and land softly.

exercises.name: Barbell complex
exercises.cue: Move through the lifts without putting the bar down.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.cue: Keep tension on the band and the toes forward.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.cue: Pull to the chest and squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Banded external rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow tucked to the ribs and a slow rotation.

exercises.name: Hip mobility flow
exercises.cue: Move slowly and breathe through each position.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cue: Move one vertebra at a time with the breath.

exercises.name: Child pose
exercises.cue: Sit back to the heels and breathe into the lower back.

exercises.name: Downward dog
exercises.cue: Push the floor away and lengthen the spine.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.cue: Rotate through the upper back and keep the hips over the knees.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: Keep the back long and fold from the hips.

exercises.name: Thoracic roll
exercises.cue: Roll slowly along the upper back with the arms crossed.

exercises.name: Quad and calf roll
exercises.cue: Pause on tight spots and breathe out.

exercises.name: Lat and glute roll
exercises.cue: Slow passes and stay off the joints.

exercises.name: Aqua walking
exercises.cue: Tall posture and a long stride against the water.

exercises.name: Aqua intervals
exercises.cue: Fast efforts followed by easy recoveries.

exercises.name: Aqua dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Press the weights down and up through the water.

exercises.name: Water jogging
exercises.cue: Run in place with high knees.

exercises.name: Rally drills
exercises.cue: Keep the ball in play and move your feet between shots.

exercises.name: Footwork ladder
exercises.cue: Quick, light feet and stay on the toes.

exercises.name: Match play
exercises.cue: Play to a set number of points with full effort.

exercises.name: Serve practice
exercises.cue: Smooth toss and a relaxed swing.
